verdict.rationale: cubic ships an official, first-party CLI that reviews local changes before you push and generates a prompt your coding agent can use to fix the bugs it finds. It also recommends connecting ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code, which fits AI-native workflows directly. Evidence is limited to brief first-party doc snippets and a probe confirming the CLI docs page, and the documented scope is local review only. missing for 10: documented command reference and install details, evidence of CLI functions beyond local review (e.g. scripting or non-interactive automation), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The cubic CLI reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.
We recommend connecting ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code for access to more capable review models.
